effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([Shambala] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 [Shambala] trait card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Gain 2 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
